component.name: EP Media Installer (epmi)
component.summary: Manage custom media slots and .emx packages on Epson SureColor printers
Eigene Papierspeicherplätze und .emx-Pakete auf Epson SureColor Druckern verwalten

description.p: EP Media Installer (epmi) manages custom paper types, printer NVRAM slots, and .emx media packages for Epson SureColor fine-art and large-format printers under Linux.

ul.li: Automatic discovery of Epson printers via CUPS and local network SNMP
Read, edit, and write the 30 custom media NVRAM slots (1..30) directly in the printer
Browse and install media packages from Epson's online catalog (all 27 SureColor SC-P and SC-T series)
One-click system installation of paper definitions and ICC profiles for the CUPS driver and LumaPrint
